from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
expected={'adapters/protocol.py','adapters/workday.py','do-again.toml','tests/test_workday_adapter.py','do-again-policy.json'}
status=subprocess.run(['git','status','--short'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
print('STATUS',status)
if any(line[3:] not in expected for line in status.splitlines()): raise SystemExit('DIRTY_TREE_CHANGED')
head=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
if head!='cf84a220a60b9c34a054b04a697c37e857a1713c': raise SystemExit('HEAD_CHANGED')
for names,deadline in [
 (['tests/test_workday_adapter.py','-k','registration_uses_only_enabled_create_account_control'],95),
 (['tests/test_workday_adapter.py'],160),
 (['tests/test_ats_adapter_contract.py'],220),
 ([],500),
]:
 cmd=[str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','--maxfail=1']+names
 p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
 try: out,err=p.communicate(timeout=deadline)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
  try: out,err=p.communicate(timeout=8)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
   os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
   out,err=p.communicate()
  print('TIMEOUT',names,out[-2500:],err[-700:])
  raise SystemExit(124)
 print('RESULT',names,'EXIT',p.returncode,'OUT',out[-3500:],'ERR',err[-450:])
 if p.returncode: raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
subprocess.run(['git','add','--','adapters/workday.py','tests/test_workday_adapter.py'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','fix: require unique enabled Workday registration button'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','push','origin','main'],cwd=repo,check=True,timeout=90)
print('VERIFIED_PUSH')
